summary: Iteration 38 — verified all 8 reported fixes (HomePage hero fallback, AdminItemForm auto-category + image URL, Paused-orders 503 block, Admin Hours time-input width, AdminOverview Filter/more buttons wiring, Live Queue refresh + toast, Orders refresh + toast, Cancellation require_reason propagation). 7/7 pytest cases pass (test_iteration38_bug_fixes.py). All 8 UI flows verified via Playwright against REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/orders.py L223-L227 pause-check fires AFTER pydantic body validation, so callers with malformed bodies see 422 instead of 503. Acceptable trade-off but worth a docstring note.
AdminItemForm: the split-useEffect auto-select uses the first category; if categories list is reordered, default may change unexpectedly. Consider tracking 'last used category' in localStorage.

CancelOrderButton openDialog reads requireReason from a snapshot — if admin toggles config after the customer page mounts but before they click cancel, customer sees stale behavior until refetch. Public config currently only fetched once on mount.

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_<uuid>@example.com guest pickup orders to exercise cancel flow (left in DB; tagged with TEST_ prefix in contact_email).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 fixes from iteration 38 verified end-to-end. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration38_bug_fixes.py (uses origin_url field — required by OrderCreate). Pause/cancellation state restored to defaults (paused=false, require_reason=true). Hero image fallback observed working (loaded unsplash photo-1571157577110 with naturalWidth=600).

verified_evidence.1_hero_image: data-testid='hero-image' loaded successfully, naturalWidth=600, src=unsplash photo-1571157577110-493b325fdd3d (fallback or primary — either way image renders).
verified_evidence.2_admin_item_form: Category dropdown auto-selects 'Starters' on /admin/catalog/new mount. Image URL field + add-image-btn successfully add unsplash photo to gallery; backend POST /api/admin/menu/items persists image_url (verified via subsequent GET /api/menu/items/{id}).
verified_evidence.3_paused_orders_503: POST /api/admin/store/pause {paused:true,reason:'Kitchen maintenance'} → subsequent POST /api/orders returns 503 with detail 'Ordering paused: Kitchen maintenance'. Unpause then succeeds with 200.
verified_evidence.5_admin_overview_links: queue-filter-btn navigates to /admin/queue?filter=open. queue-more-* navigates to /admin/queue.
verified_evidence.6_live_queue_refresh: Click data-testid='refresh-btn' → sonner toast 'Queue refreshed' appears.
verified_evidence.7_orders_refresh: Click data-testid='refresh-orders-btn' → sonner toast 'Orders refreshed' appears.
verified_evidence.8_cancel_dialog_step_skip: With PATCH /api/admin/cancellation/config {require_reason:false}, opening cancel dialog shows data-testid='cancel-refund-summary' (step 2) and hides 'cancel-reason-group' (step 1). After resetting require_reason=true, dialog opens at step 1 with reason group visible and refund summary hidden. Public GET /api/cancellation/config + cancel-eligibility both reflect the admin toggle.
